name: Infinix, Tecno and itel (XOS, HiOS and itel OS)

packages.label: Magazine lock screen
packages.reason: Puts news, games and wallpapers with ads on the lock screen.

packages.label: Palm Store
packages.reason: Preinstalled app store that pushes app promos. The Play Store does the same job.

packages.label: AHA Games
packages.reason: Game store with intrusive promo notifications.

packages.label: App Update (Palm Store)
packages.reason: Updates and suggests apps for Palm Store. Not needed once Palm Store is off.

packages.label: Chrome Assistant
packages.reason: Sets a partner home page in Chrome and uses your advertising ID.

packages.label: Carlcare
packages.reason: Service-centre app. Carlcare's website does the same if you need a repair.

packages.label: Phone Master
packages.reason: Cleaner with ads and promo notifications. Its cleaner and data-usage tools go with it.

packages.label: Hi Browser
packages.reason: Browser with ads and trackers. Set another browser as default first.

packages.label: Phoenix Browser
packages.reason: Browser with ads and news pushes. Set another browser as default first.

packages.label: Folax
packages.reason: Voice assistant with ads in its screens.

packages.label: Video player (Magic Show)
packages.reason: Video player with ads. Turn it off only if another app plays your videos.

packages.label: TranCare
packages.reason: After-sales telemetry. Little is known about what else uses it.
